verdict.rationale: Rippling markets natural-language interaction ("Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap", "Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data", "Tell Rippling what you need and agents handle ordering, routing...") suggesting employees/admins can issue plain-language requests that trigger automated IT actions. However, all evidence is first-party marketing copy with no product documentation of command syntax, scope, or limitations, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature actually working as described. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the NL command interface, independent/hands-on verification, and clarity on which IT actions can be fully executed via natural language versus just Q&A.
